kcd.role.henry.desc: Son of Martin the blacksmith from Skalitz. The voice of the story: decides in key conversations.
kcd.role.brother.desc: Martin's younger son. Your own name and story — but one family and one tragedy.
kcd.role.name: Name
kcd.role.story.title: Who were you before?
kcd.role.error.henry_taken: Henry is already taken by another player.
kcd.tip.1: You can only save by drinking Saviour Schnapps. Take a bottle or two on the road.
kcd.tip.2: People remember who entered their home. If something goes missing, they will suspect you.
kcd.tip.3: Clean clothes and a washed face help in conversation. Blood and dirt scare people off.
kcd.tip.4: Haggle wisely: a merchant's patience is not endless, and he will remember the insult.
kcd.tip.5: Skills grow with use. Want to master the sword? Pick one up.
kcd.tip.6: A party is stronger than a lone wanderer. A wounded comrade can be raised before it is too late.
kcd.tip.7: Roads are dangerous at night: bandits and Cumans do not sleep.
kcd.tip.8: Guards remember faces. Did something bad? Don't show up in town in the same clothes.
kcd.tip.9: A hungry, tired warrior fights twice as badly. Eat and sleep in time.
kcd.tip.10: The year is 1403. King Wenceslas is his brother's prisoner and Sigismund's army ravages Bohemia.
